proves.claim: Two runner pull claims over the same queue append exactly one gate-queue event holding the queued gate ids in offer order, the leased count, runnersSeen and serveStartedAt.

api.io-gate.queue-snapshot-on-change.why: Without this test the board records nothing about why a gate waited, or records the same queue on every claim.

proves.claim: A pull claim after a gate job is claimed appends a second gate-queue event without that job in queued, and a claim over an unchanged queue appends none.

api.io-gate.queue-snapshot-next.why: Without this test the snapshot can miss a queue change or repeat an unchanged one, so jobs-ahead counts read wrong.

proves.claim: At 60000 gate-shard rows and 93 offered gate jobs, a pull claim appends at most one gate-queue event, the snapshot's added p95 is printed, and its queue reads search job by index with no scan.

api.io-gate.queue-snapshot-latency.why: Without this measurement the snapshot can slow every runner claim as the board grows.
